G2 actual UIKit widths352.856/237.831 confirms interpolation; F/G410x70.2857→210x36. Samehost/nohands. Normal passive actualworkout remains failing. No fix. Please read-only assess next strongest bounded discriminator: continually changing timer/progress siblings in actual Timeline versus isolated E whose UI only changes semantic phase every8s. **Test changing timer/progress siblings next, before navigation.** The resize experiments did not reproduce the visual failure, including verified interpolation. G2’s final capture retains the stated CPU-bracketing limitation; it does not invalidate the other passing observations.

Use **one two-arm comparison**, with the existing passing fixed-size, single-host fixture:

- **Frozen:** production-style timer and progress views are present, but their displayed values remain constant.
- **Live:** identical views receive continuously changing elapsed/countdown/progress values from the existing 0.25-second TimelineView.

Both arms should retain the same scripted semantic phases, constant caption, BoardMapView, 210 × 36 leaf, and scene identity. Keep the timer/progress slots present and identically sized in both arms. Verify actual board placement as well as dimensions.

Use the timer audit’s production formatting and animation behavior. Do not introduce an artificial redraw mechanism, new timer, or additional observable state. The timeline can derive the sibling values directly; those values must not influence board selection, position, identity, or script deadlines.

A bounded **frozen/live/live/frozen** sequence is enough. Retain the existing sparse evidence and twenty captures per run, without AX, input, or per-tick logging.

Interpretation:

- **Frozen passes; live fails repeatedly:** changing sibling presentation is sufficient to expose failure in this fixture. This implicates that presentation activity as a bundle—not specifically text, progress, animation, or a framework mechanism.
- **Both pass:** changing siblings under this controlled layout are insufficient.
- **Both fail or vary:** the added presentation changed the baseline; there is no clean discriminator.

If both pass, move directly to **the exact production workout layout/containment with the controlled driver**, rather than adding more synthetic sibling variants. Navigation can remain excluded initially. That preserves the next meaningful boundary without expanding into a large arm matrix.

This test is worth doing because Timeline evaluation already passed, but **changing rendered sibling content** has not yet been isolated. No result so far selects a production fix."
